audit_identity.independence: This script does not read prior ground-truth/leakage reports.
audit_identity.role: Independent additional reviewer — RE2-TT ground truth, candidate universe, leakage, and evaluation readiness
audit_identity.scope: DATASET-WIDE METADATA FACT — all 90 RE2-TT cases; no telemetry content downloaded or inspected by this audit

candidate_universe.known_injected_label_universe_top5: TRIVIAL — five labels make Top-5 service accuracy structurally 1.0 if every label is returned.
candidate_universe.permitted_rule: Derive candidate services only from telemetry observable in the evaluated case before labels are loaded; freeze and log that set per case.

case_identifier_encoding.conclusion: Every case ID encodes the indexed root-cause service, fault, and repetition. Case IDs and their directory paths are direct leakage.

evaluation_readiness.basis: All 90 cases have a valid injection boundary and a root-cause-service evaluation label.
evaluation_readiness.protocol: Use inject_time only to define the evaluation window or to supply an externally known incident time; never expose it as an end-to-end detector feature.
evaluation_readiness.task: RCA given a known incident window

evaluation_readiness.basis: Each case has normal/faulty injection windows and metrics/traces; 89/90 also have logs.
evaluation_readiness.protocol: It can score automatic incident-window detection against the injected-fault boundary, but not a fully labelled anomaly-object/task because observed anomaly onset and affected-node labels are absent.

evaluation_readiness.basis: There is only one root-cause-service label per case and no affected/anomalous service set.
evaluation_readiness.protocol: Do not treat root_cause_service as a label for every anomalous service.

evaluation_readiness.basis: No authoritative node universe or per-node anomaly labels are available.
evaluation_readiness.protocol: NOT EVALUABLE WITH CURRENT GROUND TRUTH.

evaluation_readiness.basis: All 90 cases have a non-null root_cause_service label across five balanced services.
evaluation_readiness.protocol: Build each candidate universe from telemetry observable in that case, never from case paths, metadata labels, or known injected-service sets.
NOT EVALUABLE WITH CURRENT GROUND TRUTH.

ground_truth_availability.basis: All 90 cases are indexed as fault-injection cases and every row has an in-range inject_time with nonzero normal and faulty windows.
ground_truth_availability.limit: This is an injection-window label, not an independently annotated observed anomaly onset.

ground_truth_availability.basis: root_cause_service is non-null in all 90 metadata rows; five services are balanced at 18 cases each.
ground_truth_availability.limit: Evaluation-only label; it must not be used to form per-case model candidates or features.

ground_truth_availability.basis: fault is non-null in all 90 metadata rows; six values occur 15 times each.
ground_truth_availability.limit: Evaluation-only label; it is encoded in every case identifier.

ground_truth_availability.basis: The service label is present and exactly matches the service token in every case identifier.
ground_truth_availability.limit: There is no separate injection_target field or independent target record. The dataset does not distinguish an intended injection target from an observable causal root cause, and has no operation/resource target.

ground_truth_availability.basis: inject_time is non-null and within [time_start, time_end] for all 90 cases; every row has 720 normal and 721 faulty timesteps.
ground_truth_availability.limit: Only an evaluation/protocol boundary. It is forbidden as an end-to-end detector input.

ground_truth_availability.basis: No operation-root-cause field exists in cases.parquet, and the complete RE2-TT repository tree has no separate ground-truth artifact beyond the four telemetry/inject-time file types.
ground_truth_availability.limit: A trace operation name is an observable representation, not an operation ground-truth label.

ground_truth_availability.basis: No resource target/type/root-cause metadata field or separate RE2-TT ground-truth artifact is present.
ground_truth_availability.limit: Fault labels such as disk/socket do not identify a specific resource entity.

ground_truth_availability.basis: No affected-service/node set is in the metadata and no corresponding RE2-TT label artifact exists in the pinned tree.
ground_truth_availability.limit: The root-cause service label does not label all anomalous or affected nodes.

ground_truth_availability.basis: No propagation-path field or RE2-TT artifact is present in the metadata/tree inventory.
ground_truth_availability.limit: Span parentage cannot be promoted into a labelled causal path.

ground_truth_availability.basis: The pinned RE2-TT metadata has no indicator field and its complete repository tree contains no root_cause.txt or indicator artifact.
ground_truth_availability.limit: The official README's general benchmark description does not make a separate RE2-TT indicator field available in this pinned Hugging Face copy.

leakage_policy.reason: Every RE2-TT case ID deterministically encodes the root-cause service, fault type, and repetition.
The official directory convention carries the same root-cause-service and fault tokens as the case ID.
It is the service-ranking answer label; using it in a case-specific candidate set collapses that universe to one.
It is the service-fault answer label and is encoded in the case ID/path.
It defines the injected-fault boundary. FORBIDDEN FOR END-TO-END DETECTION INPUT.
A direct root-cause artifact would be leakage. It is absent from all 90 RE2-TT cases in the pinned repository tree.
It identifies a repetition, not a runtime observable; it must not be a model feature.

metadata_absence_checks.interpretation: Absence checks apply to the pinned metadata and pinned repository file tree, not to uninspected telemetry values.

facts_used: The README identifies RE2-TT as a 90-case, six-fault, multi-source suite and defines inject_time.txt as a fault-injection timestamp.
The README identifies cases.parquet as the index for root-cause service, fault type, and injection time.
The evaluator source treats injection time as the boundary for normal/anomalous window construction and derives candidate counts from observed metric columns after preprocessing.
